verdict.rationale: Fivetran documents sync-mode controls (Soft Delete, Live, History modes), automatic delete-capture from source, row filtering, data blocking and column hashing, which let users shape what data is retained or removed in the destination, and the official MCP server exposes a `read/write/delete` scope plus a `DISALLOWED_ACTIONS` denylist so an AI agent's delete capability can be explicitly controlled. However there's no documentation of a formal data-retention policy, GDPR/right-to-erasure workflow, or granular per-record deletion request mechanism aimed at an AI-native operator. Missing for 10: explicit retention-period configuration, compliance-oriented deletion/erasure workflow docs, independent confirmation that MCP delete scope is safe/reliable in practice.
